pages.text: Forged at the Convergence Altar: an Astral Core as catalyst; Starmetal, Sunsteel and Moonsilver, a Void Shard and two feathers as offerings; 2000 pure starlight. The key alone carries no one - it lights an Astral Gate.

Build a closed frame of $(item)Astral Gate$() blocks standing upright, like a door: the opening at least 2 wide and 3 tall (corners are optional). Set the Ascension Key into the frame and step into the light for a few heartbeats.
The Firmament is light: you fall slowly and land softly. Fall off the islands and the sky catches you and sets you down at the nearest island. The gate behind the landing leads home.
